name: Cinematic Drafting
thesis: Kelwin reads like a film shot inside an engineering office. A sets the restraint (graphite, paper and one red, two-voice wide statements, generous space, every section echoing the hero). C proves each argument with one exact technical drawing, never a wall of cells or tiny text. B brings calm only where you named it.

contributions.what: The hero, the head grammar on every section, two-voice statements, the FIG. plate, strips instead of cards, and the space.
One 1px technical drawing per section, under strict limits: a few large callouts, at most two dimension lines, nothing under 11px.
Ledgers that open in place, the architecture loop with 'How it closes', and the calm of the final call.

vocab.name: Trace · signal lines
vocab.what: Routed 1px signal lines with nodes that latch as the line draws; a knot untangles into a clean route.

vocab.name: Strata · isometric slabs
vocab.what: Thin isometric slabs that drop in and compress from exploded to assembled.

vocab.name: Field · point cloud
vocab.what: A point cloud that resolves from scatter into a 10×10 field, one point per percent.

vocab.name: Orbit · rings and arcs
vocab.what: Concentric rings and arcs: a loop closes, and rings accrete outward and stay.

vocab.name: Measure · bars and ticks
vocab.what: Calibrated rulers, ticks and gantt bars that measure out time and progress.

vocab.name: Contour · waveforms and contours
vocab.what: Waveforms and contour lines: noise settles into one clean signal.

vocab.name: Lattice · the resolving grid
vocab.what: A warped grid that resolves into a true one, from surface to architecture.

vocab.name: Folio · sheets
vocab.what: Tagged document sheets that resolve from draft to finished as they change hands.
